quranTranslation.text: And We have guarded it from every outcast devil,

explanation.bs: „I sačuvali smo ga od svakog prokletog šejtana“ – Allah čuva nebo, kako Njemu priliči.
explanation.en: “And We have guarded it from every outcast devil” — Allah guards the heaven, as befits Him.

quranTranslation.text: Tell the believing men to lower their gaze and be modest. That is purer for them. Lo! Allah is aware of what they do.

explanation.bs: „Reci vjernicima da obore poglede svoje i da čuvaju stidna mjesta svoja.“
explanation.en: “Tell the believing men to lower their gaze and be modest [literally: guard their private parts].”

quranTranslation.text: And when they opened their belongings they discovered that their merchandise had been returned to them. They said: O our father! What (more) can we ask? Here is our merchandise returned to us. We shall get provision for our folk and guard our brother, and we shall have the extra measure of a camel (load). This (that we bring now) is a light measure.

explanation.bs: Jusufova braća ocu: „… a brata ćemo svoga čuvati.“
explanation.en: Joseph's brothers to their father: “… and guard our brother.”

quranTranslation.text: (Saying): Eat ye and feed your cattle. Lo! herein verily are portents for men of thought.

explanation.bs: „Jedite i napasajte svoja stada“ – izvorno značenje; ar-Rāġib navodi ovaj ajet.
explanation.en: “Eat ye and feed your cattle [literally: pasture them]” — the root sense; ar-Rāġib cites this ayah.

gloss.en: to tend, to pasture; to observe

quranTranslation.text: Then We caused Our messengers to follow in their footsteps; and We caused Jesus, son of Mary, to follow, and gave him the Gospel, and placed compassion and mercy in the hearts of those who followed him. But monasticism they invented - We ordained it not for them - only seeking Allah's pleasure, and they observed it not with right observance. So We give those of them who believe their reward, but many of them are evil-livers.

explanation.bs: „… pa je nisu pazili onako kako je treba paziti“ – ar-Rāġib: nisu je čuvali kako dolikuje.
explanation.en: “… and they observed it not with right observance” — ar-Rāġib: they did not keep it as it should be kept.

gloss.en: to tend, to pasture; to observe

quranTranslation.text: Is he whom We have promised a fair promise which he will find (true) like him whom We suffer to enjoy awhile the comfort of the life of the world, then on the Day of Resurrection he will be of those arraigned?

explanation.bs: „Zar je onaj kome smo dali lijepo obećanje, pa će ga i dočekati …“ – obećanje dobra; ar-Rāġib navodi ovaj ajet.
explanation.en: “Is he whom We have promised a fair promise which he will find (true)” — a promise of good; ar-Rāġib cites this ayah.

quranTranslation.text: And they will bid thee hasten on the Doom, and Allah faileth not His promise, but lo! a Day with Allah is as a thousand years of what ye reckon.

explanation.bs: „I traže od tebe da kazna požuri, a Allah neće iznevjeriti Svoje obećanje …“ – ‚obećanje‘ je ovdje kazna: ar-Rāġibov primjer za waʿd u zlu.
explanation.en: “And they will bid thee hasten on the Doom, and Allah faileth not His promise” — the ‘promise’ here is the punishment: ar-Rāġib's example of waʿd for evil.

quranTranslation.text: Lo! verily all that is in the heavens and the earth is Allah's. Lo! verily Allah's promise is true. But most of them know not.

explanation.bs: „… Allahovo obećanje je zaista istina …“ – ar-Rāġib: proživljenje i uzvrat, i za dobro i za zlo.
explanation.en: “Lo! verily Allah's promise is true.” — ar-Rāġib: the Rising and the requital, both good and evil.

quranTranslation.text: And verily We shall make you to dwell in the land after them. This is for him who feareth My Majesty and feareth My threats.

explanation.bs: „… To je za onoga ko se boji stajanja preda Mnom i boji se Moje prijetnje.“ – ar-Rāġib navodi ove riječi.
explanation.en: “This is for him who feareth My Majesty and feareth My threats.” — ar-Rāġib cites these words.

quranTranslation.text: And the dwellers in the wood, and the folk of Tubb'a: every one denied their messengers, therefor My threat took effect.

explanation.bs: „… svi su utjerali u laž poslanike, pa se obistinila Moja prijetnja.“
explanation.en: “… every one denied their messengers, therefor My threat took effect.”

quranTranslation.text: He saith: Contend not in My presence, when I had already proffered unto you the warning.

explanation.bs: „Ne prepirite se preda Mnom, a Ja sam vam prijetnju unaprijed poslao.“ – ar-Rāġib navodi ovaj ajet.
explanation.en: “Contend not in My presence, when I had already proffered unto you the warning [al-waʿīd]” — ar-Rāġib cites this ayah.

quranTranslation.text: O Children of Adam! We have revealed unto you raiment to conceal your shame, and splendid vesture, but the raiment of restraint from evil, that is best. This is of the revelations of Allah, that they may remember.

explanation.bs: „O sinovi Ademovi, poslali smo vam odjeću koja skriva vašu golotinju, i ukras; a odjeća bogobojaznosti – ona je najbolja“ – ar-Rāġib navodi ovaj ajet.
explanation.en: “O Children of Adam! We have revealed unto you raiment to conceal your shame, and splendid vesture, but the raiment of restraint from evil, that is best” — ar-Rāġib cites this ayah.

quranTranslation.text: Allah coineth a similitude: a township that dwelt secure and well content, its provision coming to it in abundance from every side, but it disbelieved in Allah's favours, so Allah made it experience the garb of dearth and fear because of what they used to do.

explanation.bs: „… pa joj je Allah dao da okusi odjeću gladi i straha …“ – glad i strah koji obuhvate grad kao odjeća; ar-Rāġib navodi ovaj ajet.
explanation.en: “so Allah made it experience the garb of dearth and fear” — hunger and fear wrapping the town like clothing; ar-Rāġib cites this ayah.

quranTranslation.text: And have appointed the night as a cloak,

explanation.bs: „I noć smo učinili odjećom“ – noć koja pokriva kao odjeća.
explanation.en: “And have appointed the night as a cloak” — the night that covers like clothing.

quranTranslation.text: As for such, theirs will be Gardens of Eden, wherein rivers flow beneath them; therein they will be given armlets of gold and will wear green robes of finest silk and gold embroidery, reclining upon throne therein. Blest the reward, and fair the resting-place!

explanation.bs: „… i oblačit će zelene haljine od tanke svile i brokata …“ – haljine stanovnika Dženneta; ar-Rāġib navodi ove riječi.
explanation.en: “and will wear green robes of finest silk and gold embroidery” — the garments of the people of Paradise; ar-Rāġib cites these words.

quranTranslation.text: And lo! whenever I call unto them that Thou mayst pardon them they thrust their fingers in their ears and cover themselves with their garments and persist (in their refusal) and magnify themselves in pride.

explanation.bs: Nuh: „… stavljali su prste u uši i umotavali se u svoje haljine …“ – haljine kojima se pokriva da se ne čuje i ne vidi.
explanation.en: Noah: “they thrust their fingers in their ears and cover themselves with their garments” — garments drawn over oneself so as not to hear or see.

quranTranslation.text: As for women past child-bearing, who have no hope of marriage, it is no sin for them if they discard their (outer) clothing in such a way as not to show adornment. But to refrain is better for them. Allah is Hearer, Knower.

explanation.bs: „Starim ženama koje se više ne nadaju udaji nema krivnje ako odlože svoje haljine [gornju odjeću], a ne pokazuju ukras …“ – haljine koje se skidaju i odlažu.
explanation.en: “it is no sin for them if they discard their (outer) clothing [ṯiyāb] in such a way as not to show adornment” — garments that are taken off and laid aside.

quranTranslation.text: And Allah hath given you, of that which He hath created, shelter from the sun; and hath given you places of refuge in the mountains, and hath given you coats to ward off the heat from you, and coats (of armour) to save you from your own foolhardiness. Thus doth He perfect His favour unto you, in order that ye may surrender (unto Him).

explanation.bs: „… i dao vam košulje koje vas čuvaju od vrućine i košulje koje vas čuvaju u vašem boju …“ – ar-Rāġib navodi ovaj ajet: jedne od drugih, kaže on, štite u boju.
explanation.en: “and hath given you coats to ward off the heat from you, and coats (of armour) to save you from your own foolhardiness” — ar-Rāġib cites this ayah: they guard some of you, he says, from the violence of others.

quranTranslation.text: Their raiment of pitch, and the Fire covering their faces,

explanation.bs: „Košulje su im od katrana, a lica im prekriva Vatra“ – ar-Rāġib navodi ovaj ajet.
explanation.en: “Their raiment [sarābīl] of pitch, and the Fire covering their faces” — ar-Rāġib cites this ayah.
